title: Angkor Empire Marathon 2026 Review: What the 11th Edition Was Like
seo_title: Angkor Empire Marathon 2026 Review | Siem Reap
meta_description: Angkor Empire Marathon 2026 review: 6,500 runners from 51 countries at Angkor Wat on 2 August, a 25% rise on 2025, over 42K, 21K, 10K and 3K.
dek: Cambodia's temple marathon held its 11th edition in front of Angkor Wat on 2 August 2026, with a bigger field from 51 countries. Here is what it was like, from the report on it.
verdict: The Angkor Empire Marathon's setting is its selling point: it is run at Angkor Wat, a UNESCO World Heritage site [1]. The 11th edition, on 2 August 2026, drew 6,500 runners from 51 countries, 1,050 of them from abroad, over 42 km, 21 km, 10 km and 3 km [1]. That was 25% more than in 2025 [1]. If you want to run a marathon among the Angkor temples, this is the one that does it over the full distance. Go in knowing that an August race in Siem Reap is hot, humid and in the rainy season.

sections.heading: The 11th Edition
paragraphs: The race was held on 2 August 2026 at Angkor Wat in Siem Reap province, and drew 6,500 runners from 51 countries: 5,450 Cambodians and 1,050 international runners [1]. China, Japan and the United Kingdom sent the most overseas runners [1].
There were four categories: 42 km, 21 km, 10 km and 3 km [1]. Senior Minister Thong Khon, in charge of sports development, welcomed the runners and said participation was up 25% on 2025 [1].

sections.heading: Why Runners Come
paragraphs: The setting is the reason. The race is run at Angkor, a UNESCO World Heritage site, and the minister linked it to tourism in Angkor National Park and to support for Cambodian children [1].
The Angkor Empire Marathon is separate from the Angkor Wat International Half Marathon, which is held in December. If you want the full distance among the temples, this is the race.

sections.heading: Should You Enter Next Year?
paragraphs: If you want a destination marathon with a setting you will not find anywhere else, yes. The field keeps growing, and more than a thousand runners travelled from abroad in 2026.
Pace it for the climate. Early August in Siem Reap is hot, humid and in the rainy season, so run to conditions and treat the time as secondary to the experience.
This review is compiled from a published report on the 2026 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran the Angkor Empire Marathon in 2026?
faqs.answer: 6,500 runners from 51 countries took part in the 11th edition on 2 August 2026 at Angkor Wat, Siem Reap: 5,450 Cambodians and 1,050 international runners. That was 25% more than in 2025, with China, Japan and the UK sending the most overseas runners.

faqs.question: What distances does the Angkor Empire Marathon offer?
faqs.answer: Four in 2026: the full marathon, a half marathon, 10 km and a 3 km. All are run at Angkor, starting in front of Angkor Wat temple.

faqs.question: Is the Angkor Empire Marathon the same as the Angkor Wat Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: No. The Angkor Empire Marathon is held in August and includes the full marathon. The Angkor Wat International Half Marathon is a separate event held in December, with the half marathon as its longest race.
